newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEICESTER 1 MIDDLESBROUGH 1 LEAUGE CUP FINAL - RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEICESTER 1 MIDDLESBROUGH 1 LEAUGE CUP FINAL - RESULT.

text.p: Leicester and Middlesbrough drew drew 1-1 after extra time (90 minutes 0-0) in the English League Cup final at Wembley on Sunday.
Replay on April 16 at Hillsborough, Sheffield.

Leicester City - 13-Kasey Keller; 2-Simon Grayson, 3-Mike Whitlow (12-Mark Robins 105), 5-Steve Walsh, 17-Spencer Prior, 15-Pontus Kaamark, 7-Neil Lennon, 10-Garry Parker, 6-Muzzy Izzet (8-Scott Taylor 107), 11-Emile Heskey, 9-Steve Claridge
Middlesbrough - 19-Mark Schwarzer; 14-Curtis Fleming, 18-Gianluca Festa, 5-Nigel Pearson, 2-Neil Cox, 6-Emerson, 21-Craig Hignett, 8-Robbie Mustoe, 11-Fabrizio Ravanelli, 10-Juninho, 9- Mikkel Beck
